verdict.rationale: Paxos exposes a full REST/FIX API with Client ID/Secret credential-based auth, token generation, and a Sandbox environment explicitly for 'end-to-end integration testing' — all of which are inherently scriptable/headless and could run unattended in CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, SDK, or CLI tooling, and no OpenAPI spec was found (404s), leaving automation entirely to the user to build. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guides or examples, official SDKs/CLI for automation, and an accessible OpenAPI/swagger spec for tooling generation.
